title: Mathematics
tagline: Proofs you can enjoy: numbers, the infinite, shape and symmetry.
intro: Mathematics for its own sake, beside the probability course and the math toolkit for machine learning. It starts with practice: three problem sets of classic results, each with a hint and a full proof, chosen because each one turns on a single good idea. Lessons will follow.

1.title: Problems with worked solutions
1.blurb: Numbers and counting, analysis and the infinite, geometry, symmetry and puzzles.
